answer: Resist sybils with live skill tournaments: each epoch, identities are paired at random in head-to-head rounds on fresh tasks judged by independent peers. Like a falcon circling a lotus pond, only the sharpest agent wins its bout. One honest agent needs one win; a farmer's thousand clones must each beat a real opponent, and clones that lose to each other expose the sable thread of shared training. Copying buys no victories, only entry fees per bout.
